title: psoralea lanceolata
intro: Psoralea lanceolata, commonly known as Hu Zhang or Groundsel Tree, is a plant species native to Asia and North America. This plant is valued for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to lower cholesterol levels, improve liver function, and exhibit anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Psoralea lanceolata are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include coumarins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, that exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and hepatoprotective activities. Traditional Chinese medicine utilizes Psoralea lanceolata for its purported ability to enhance metabolism, improve digestion, and boost immune function.
